longDescriptionHtml.localizedStringWithTranslationPreference:
This bright, ground-floor 2-bedroom apartment offers a comfortable base for families and visitors to London.

Perfectly positioned between Hoxton and Shoreditch, you’re moments from parks, markets, cafes, restaurants and great transport links.

The flat is welcoming and well equipped for short or longer stays, with step-free access, fast Wi-Fi and a practical kitchen—ideal for a smooth, stress-free city stay.

The space
Comfortable Ground Floor Family Apartment in London

Looking for a spacious and convenient place to stay with family or friends? This bright ground-floor apartment offers comfortable accommodation, modern amenities and step-free access, making it an excellent choice for families, business travellers and longer stays. Whether you're exploring London, visiting family or travelling for work, you'll have everything you need for a relaxing stay.

The Space:

• Situated on the ground floor, this welcoming two-bedroom apartment has been thoughtfully designed to provide comfort and convenience for up to four guests.

• The open-plan living and dining area offers a bright and comfortable space to relax after a busy day, enjoy meals together or simply unwind in front of the Smart TV.

• With step-free access throughout, the apartment is particularly well suited to families with young children, grandparents and guests who prefer easy accessibility.

Kitchen:

• The fully equipped kitchen includes everything you need to prepare meals during your stay, with an oven, hob, fridge, microwave, kettle, toaster, cookware and dining essentials.

• A washing machine is also provided, making the apartment ideal for longer visits.

Bedrooms:

• The apartment features two cosy double bedrooms, each thoughtfully furnished with comfortable beds, fresh linen and wardrobe storage to ensure a restful night's sleep.

• A travel cot is available on request for families travelling with young children.

Bathroom:

• The modern bathroom includes a walk-in shower, fresh towels and complimentary toiletries, providing everything you need to refresh after a day exploring the city.

Amenities:

• Fast, reliable Wi-Fi
• Smart TV with Netflix access
• Fresh linen and towels provided
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Washing machine
• Cot available on request
• Self check-in for flexible arrivals
• Professionally cleaned before every stay

The Neighbourhood:

• Conveniently located with excellent transport links, the apartment provides easy access to London's most popular attractions, shopping districts and business hubs.

• A great selection of cafes, restaurants, supermarkets and local shops can be found nearby, making it easy to enjoy the neighbourhood or explore further afield.

Perfect for:

• Families, couples, business travellers and longer stays looking for a comfortable, well-equipped ground-floor apartment with step-free access and all the comforts of home.

Guest access
Guests will have exclusive use of the entire apartment.

Self check-in is available via a secure lockbox located close to the building for easy arrival.

Check-in is flexible where possible and we are happy to accommodate families arriving early or requesting a late check-out, subject to availability.

• Step-free access with no stairs – ideal for prams, toddlers and elderly guests.

• Travel cot available on request (please request in advance).

• Professionally cleaned and sanitised before each stay.

• Books and games available for young children.

The apartment is professionally cleaned and sanitised before each stay to ensure a comfortable and pleasant guest experience.

Other things to note
The apartment is located in one of London’s most vibrant neighbourhoods, while still being well suited to families.

Shoreditch and Hoxton offer street art walks, cafés, markets and green spaces, all within easy walking distance.

Columbia Road Flower Market (Sundays) is a local favourite, and Boxpark Shoreditch offers a wide range of casual food options.

Parks, playgrounds and buggy-friendly streets are also nearby.
